description: Smoke task: pre_task launches Google Earth Pro and waits for its window to register. The verifier passes when the app is running with a registered LaunchServices window. No agent action required — this exists to validate the env end-to-end (install → launch → screenshot) and to give a known-good baseline before adding real in-app navigation tasks.
natural_language: Wait. The task launches Google Earth Pro before the agent gets control; no action is required.
